pins.description: The behaviors of today that this item puts at risk, each with the test that pins it. Three to eight

name.description: The behavior in plain English, as the item's owner would say it. One sentence, present tense

kind.description: cited: a test that exists pins it. written: this result writes the test

file.description: The test's file, relative to the repository's root

where.description: The production code or template that behaves this way: path:line or path:line-line

quote.description: Two to fifteen words copied exactly from the place cited

files.description: Each new test file, whole. Empty when every pin is cited

path.description: A new file under src/test/java/, relative to the repository's root

content.description: The complete Java source of the file

target_classes.description: The production classes whose behavior the pins record, as files under src/main/java/. The mutation sensor changes these

suspects.description: Behavior of today that looks wrong. Empty when nothing does

behavior.description: What the code does, in one sentence

why.description: Why it looks wrong, and against what: a requirement, a decision record, or plain expectation

quote.description: Two to fifteen words copied exactly from the place cited

gaps.description: What could not be pinned and why, for example behavior that lives only in a template no test renders; empty when nothing

summary.description: Two sentences at most, for the item's owner
